selection_policy: Selected from CORE then IMPORTANT fresh study units using allocation priority and decision-specific evidence readiness only, before seed inspection.

opportunities.learner_decision: Recognize early local-anesthetic systemic toxicity after local-anesthetic exposure.
Give dantrolene promptly for a suspected malignant-hyperthermia crisis.
Diagnose heart failure from a compatible syndrome plus objective cardiac abnormality.
Order echocardiography to characterize suspected valvular heart disease.
Offer tranexamic acid as a non-hormonal option for stable heavy menstrual bleeding when contraception is not desired.
Use observation rather than active treatment for an asymptomatic fibroid.
Offer Tdap during every pregnancy, ideally at 27–32 weeks.
Arrange maternal follow-up within 48 hours after postpartum discharge.
Proceed with routine vaccination when a child has only a mild acute illness.
Recommend supine sleep on a firm, flat, separate infant sleep surface.

opportunities.study_unit: Approach to the Infant/Child with Dehydration
opportunities.learner_decision: Use oral rehydration solution for mild pediatric dehydration.
Select polyethylene glycol 3350 for maintenance treatment of functional constipation.
Explore the patient's understanding before giving serious-illness information in small plain-language portions and checking understanding.
Interpret a reported population rate only with its defined population and denominator.
Explain a lower positive predictive value by the lower prevalence in the tested population when sensitivity and specificity are unchanged.

opportunities.study_unit: Effectiveness of Interventions and Measures of Effect
opportunities.learner_decision: Explain why identical relative risk reductions can produce different absolute benefits when baseline risks differ.
Secure continuous observation and arrange emergency psychiatric assessment for imminent suicide risk.
Select a guideline-supported first-line antimanic agent for acute mania.
Identify and correct the reversible cause while providing supportive delirium care.
Offer buprenorphine/naloxone as first-line opioid agonist treatment when appropriate.
Offer watchful waiting to a carefully selected patient with an asymptomatic or minimally symptomatic inguinal hernia.
Do not order ankle radiographs when the Ottawa ankle rules are negative.
Order scrotal ultrasonography for a suspicious painless intratesticular mass.
Refer persistent cryptorchidism by six months corrected age without routine imaging.
